m: The {Tailor} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Waiting Room}, where a patient's **leg** is so long it pokes out of the window towards the *moon*. The Tailor measures it, but the **leg** suddenly does a *u-turn*, swings back in, and kicks the receptionist's coffee into the fish tank.

The {Dentist} hides in the {Basement} of the {Mansion} at midnight, too scared to come out. Then the *moon* outside turns into a *sunrise*, and a warm glow fills his chest with **courage**. He marches upstairs, drill raised, and pulls out the vampire's fangs. Never has a dentist shown such **courage** before breakfast.

The {Juggler} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} juggling lemons, and every guest's mouth fills with **saliva**. *Water drops* drip from their chins onto the tiles. An artist catches them with a *writing brush* and paints a portrait of a lemon using pure **saliva**. The Juggler slips on it and falls into the chimney.

The {Sailor} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Pool} and sees a *standing person* in the deep *valley* of the diving pit, about to throw a fish into the water before swimming. "It's the local **custom**," he says. So the Sailor throws a fish. Everyone throws a fish. Soon the **custom** fills the pool with mackerel.

The {Baker} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} into a loud *quarrel* between two bankers, each with a *small speech bubble* jammed with numbers. They **debate** whether a doughnut is money. The bubbles bump and pop. The Baker eats the doughnut, so they start a new **debate** about the Baker.

The {Shepherd} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Youth Club} under the *moon* and puffs out his **chest** like a pigeon. A tiny treasure *chest* pops out of his shirt, full of sheep stickers. The teenagers cheer. He puffs again, and his **chest** grows so big it blocks out the moonlight.

The {Shepherd} sleeps in the {Basement} of the {Cat Café} until an *emperor* bursts in carrying the *sun* on a golden tray. "Wake up! It's **dawn**!" Light floods every corner. The cats yowl, the coffee boils, and the Shepherd realises the emperor brings **dawn** to the basement every single morning, whether you like it or not.

The {Juggler} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Inn} and lands on a table where a *strong arm* is challenging everyone to arm-wrestle. The Juggler grips it. With incredible **strength** the arm slams him through the table, the floor, and into the cellar. He crawls back up with new **strength**, juggling the splinters.

The {Pirate} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Inn} with one *cut cake* and one *shell* coin to his name. He is so **poor** that he slices the cake into a hundred crumbs to feed the whole crew. The innkeeper takes the shell as rent. The Pirate, still **poor**, sleeps in the hat stand.

The {Robot} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Funfair} and finds a *standing person* laying *two planks* across a puddle so a duckling can cross. The Robot is moved: so **kind**! It lays down two more planks for a snail, a frog and a grandmother. Soon the whole fair is a maze of **kind** little bridges.

The {Ghost} drifts into the {Basement} of the {Boathouse} and finds a *standing person* and a *monkey* who have bumped into each other **by chance**. They are wearing the same hat. They stare. Then they discover they share a birthday and a favourite banana. All **by chance**, and the Ghost faints with surprise.

The {Juggler} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beach} house pushing a *cart* piled with seashells, while each shell lets out a *whisper* of gossip. He must **compile** them all into one book. He sorts, stacks and staples. The crabs keep whispering more, and the book he **compiles** grows into a ten-volume encyclopedia of crab scandal.

The {Baker} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar}, waves a flag and declares the roof a new *country*. He paints borders round the skylights. The pigeons apply for passports. By lunchtime the tiny **nation** has its own bread money and anthem, and the planes must ask the **nation** permission to land.

The {Hunter} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Waiting Room} as a *standing heart* rises out of a pile of *ash*, beating faster and faster. Its colour comes back, red and shiny. The patients below are cured one by one. The Hunter cheers: the heart can **restore** anything. It even **restores** his burned toast.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Island} hut and finds a lazy *freeloader* in her deckchair, eating her snacks and wearing her whistle. He **relies on** her to rescue him, fetch drinks and fan him. She sighs, because he'll always **rely on** her, even when he floats away on a lilo.

The {Cheerleader} cartwheels onto the {Rooftop} of the {Mint} and unrolls a long *scroll* in a perfect **circle** round the chimney. A wooden *fence* pops up along it. Coins roll out of the mint and race round and round inside the **circle**, unable to stop.

The {Magician} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Fort} at *sunset*, blindfolded. A *helping hand* guides her fingers to **touch** a cannon, a soldier's moustache and a sleeping cat. She guesses each one by feel. Then she reaches out to **touch** the sun itself, and it sizzles like a pancake.

The {Yogi} lies in the {Basement} of the {Hangar} next to a *standing person* with an *upward gaze*, staring at the ceiling. "What's up there?" The Yogi has to **look up** too. A plane is parked on the ceiling, upside down, its pilot waving. Everyone who walks in has to **look up** and wave back.

The {Robot} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Casino}, where a calendar shows a strange *leap month*: thirteen weeks of rain. *Water drops* trickle down the roulette wheels. The Robot's metal goes soft and **moist**, the cards turn soggy, and the croupier's moustache curls. Everything stays **moist** until the extra month runs out.

The {Dentist} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Waiting Room} as a *sparrow* drops one clump of *soil* after another next to him. Soon there's a **pile** as tall as the chimney. The sparrow builds a nest on top. The Dentist adds a **pile** of old teeth to it and calls it art.

The {Pirate} crashes through the {Trapdoor} into the {Jungle} and lands *side by side* with a big round *stone*. They **bump** foreheads. Bonk! The stone rolls into a tree, which **bumps** a monkey, which bumps a parrot, until the whole jungle is bouncing like pinballs.

The {Tailor} paddles a little **boat** into the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring}, through a flooded *courtyard*. The *boat* is small enough to fit in a bathtub. The boxers climb aboard, one by one, until it sinks. The Tailor stitches a bigger **boat** out of their gloves.

The {Sheriff} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} hanging a *portrait* next to a *grain stalk*. It's crooked. She nudges it **slightly** left. Now it's crooked the other way. She nudges it **slightly** right. A pigeon lands on it and the whole tower tilts, just a little.

The {Chef} hurries up the {Staircase} of the {Beehive} with a birthday cake, but there's a giant *ruler* blocking the *road* to the queen's chamber. He measures his way round it. Two hours pass. He arrives **late**: the party is over, the bees are asleep, and the cake is buzzing. **Late** again!

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Stadium} onto a *balance scale* where a *cart* sits on one side. One car, two buses, three tractors: she has to count each vehicle with the **counter for vehicles**, 辆. The scale tips. Every **counter for vehicles** clicks like a turnstile as more trucks roll in.

The {Firefighter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} house and finds a rusty *shed* with a rocket *launch pad* on top. "I **abolish** this!" she yells, and sprays it with foam. The launch pad sinks into the lake. Then she decides to **abolish** the shed, the ducks' rules, and Mondays too.

The {Juggler} plunges through the {Trapdoor} into the {Boxing Ring}, where two teams play *tug of war* with a rope made of *icicles*. The icicles melt, washing the canvas sparkling **clean**. Every boxer slips over. The referee holds up a mirror-bright ring: it has never been so **clean**.

The {Shepherd} crawls across the {Rooftop} of the {Youth Club} and steps on a *booby trap*. Snap! Out leaps a **fierce** guinea pig with teeth like nails, growling. It chases him round the chimney. The teenagers below cheer for the **fierce** little beast as it tears the Shepherd's woolly jumper to ribbons.

The {Sheriff} kicks open the {Basement} of the {Pool} building and finds a *busy man* at a desk tangled in a *fishing net* of paperwork. It's the town's tax **office**. Stamps fly, phones ring, forms flap like fish. The Sheriff tries to arrest him, but she leaves the **office** with three forms to fill in.

The {Baker} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} hut and meets a *pioneer* building a **wall** out of wet *soil* and sand. Brick after brick, it grows higher than the waves. The sea crashes against it and stops. The Baker leans on the **wall** to eat a sandwich, and the whole thing collapses.

The {Yogi} falls through the {Trapdoor} into the {Museum} as muddy *footsteps* charge towards the crown jewels. A *porter* grabs a suitcase and holds it up like a shield to **defend** them. Thieves bounce off. The Yogi joins in, using a meditation mat to **defend** the dinosaurs.

The {Firefighter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Jungle} temple and a line of monkeys carry a golden *tribute* basket towards her. Bananas, mangoes, a tiny crown. They kneel and **offer** it. She politely accepts. The monkeys look delighted and **offer** her their grandmother too.

The {Shepherd} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mint} on a giant *spinning top*. It starts to **spin** faster and faster, and coins fly off in every direction like sparks. Sheep whirl around him. When it finally stops, he keeps on **spinning** for three more minutes.

The {Dentist} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} lighthouse in a fluffy *winter coat* as snow starts to fall. The lagoon freezes, seals skate, and icicles hang from his nose. It's **winter** already! He pulls teeth from a penguin who sits patiently in the long **winter** queue.

The {King} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Swamp} hut into a dark **mine** full of glowing *stone*. Miners wheel carts out of a little *shed* at the bottom. He swings a pickaxe and strikes gold, then mud, then a frog. The frog declares itself owner of the **mine**.

The {Tailor} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Island} to a wooden *stage* where a *helping hand* is trying to **lift** a giant coconut. It strains, it wobbles. The Tailor helps. They **lift** it high above their heads to great applause, and it bonks the Tailor on the nose.

The {Dentist} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} and lands on a *bolt of cloth* wrapped round a huge **egg**. A *bug* knocks on it from inside. Crack! Out hops a baby chicken wearing the bug as a hat. The Dentist wraps up another **egg** to see what comes out.

The {Chef} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Funfair} carousel just as the *sun* rises. A giant *clam* opens on the top step, yawning, with a fried egg inside. "Good **morning**!" says the clam. The Chef serves breakfast on the merry-go-round, and every **morning** after that the clam wants toast.

The {Firefighter} creeps down the {Staircase} of the {Pool} where a *standing person* and a *dog* lie low behind the diving board, flat as pancakes. "**Lie low**!" they whisper; the lifeguard is coming. The Firefighter flattens herself too. They **lie low** for an hour, until the dog sneezes.

The {Chef} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Waiting Room} as a huge *mouth* opens in a *yawn*. Then it starts to **blow**. Hats fly off, patients spin like weathervanes, the clock blows away. The Chef holds onto his pot, but the mouth **blows** the soup out and across the town.

The {Juggler} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} hut and catches a *bird* in his *right hand*. It's a **chicken** that won't stop laying eggs. He juggles the eggs, the **chicken** clucks along, and the whole roof fills with omelettes when the sun comes out.

The {Baker} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} house and meets a *standing person* with a *spitting mouth* that copies everything twice. One cherry stone becomes two, then four, then eight. The Baker's buns double, then grow ten **times** bigger. Soon there are a hundred **times** as many buns as fish in the lake.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Pool} with a bowl of sticky *rice* and mashes it into a gluey **paste**. A cat's *whiskers* get stuck in it. Then the cat. Then the Hunter. He tries to peel himself off the wall, but the **paste** holds everyone like a giant wallpaper.

The {Cheerleader} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Inn} with a *spring planter* full of tall *grain stalk* shoots. At the top, a terracotta warrior stamps it with a seal: "**Qin**, first empire!" Clay soldiers march out of the planter. The innkeeper serves them tea, and the whole **Qin** army refuses to leave.

The {Dentist} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Casino} holding a giant drill, and the gamblers raise a *shield* of poker tables against him. He drills; the **shield** holds. They fling chips at him. He raises his own **shield**, a gold tray, and the chips bounce back into the slot machines.

The {Baker} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Lake} house where a little *tree* grows a single teacup on every branch. A *no sign* says DO NOT PICK. He picks one anyway, fills the **cup** with lake water, and the tree cries. It grows another **cup** to hold its tears.

The {Zookeeper} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} building with a *stepladder* made of *grain stalk* bundles. A landlord pops out. "That ladder costs **rent**!" The zookeeper pays with a banana. The next day, the landlord wants **rent** for the clouds, the wind, and the view.

The {Cheerleader} cartwheels up the {Staircase} of the {Beach} house onto a *horse* that is clearly an *oddball*: it wears flippers and sunglasses. She tries to **ride** it, but it walks backwards. She stands on its back doing pom-pom routines, and the horse decides to **ride** on her instead.

The {Firefighter} drags herself up the {Staircase} of the {Spa} carrying a *flat tyre* that has lost all its air. She is so **tired** she could sleep on the steam room bench. The tyre sighs and flops on her lap, just as **tired**, and they snore together in the jacuzzi.

The {Lifeguard} marches up the {Staircase} of the {Lagoon} palace, which is carved into a whole *hillside*. Trumpets blare, banners unroll, fireworks shoot from the cliffs. It's a **grand** opening for a swimming pool the size of a sea. She cuts the ribbon with her teeth, the **grand** fountain erupts, and she is washed back down the hill.

The {Jockey} lies in the {Basement} of the {Funfair}'s first-aid tent while a doctor peers at his *thick hair*. A *small speech bubble* pops up: "Hmm, candyfloss in the scalp." The doctor tries to **diagnose** him with a stethoscope, a magnifying glass and a hair dryer. Finally she **diagnoses** him: a severe case of rollercoaster.

The {Ninja} sneaks up the {Staircase} of the {Pool} and finds a weary *drudge* carrying every towel, float and inflatable crocodile for a lazy king. He's treated like a **slave**. The Ninja cuts his ropes and hands the towels back to the king. Now the king huffs up the stairs, no longer anyone's **slave**-driver.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} and catches an *eavesdropper* with his ear pressed to the wall. A *helping hand* grabs the words floating out and stuffs them in a jar. Every secret it can **take in**, it swallows. The jar burps. It wants to **take in** the Sheriff's secrets too.

The {Sailor} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar}, waving his arms about, and everything starts to fall out of his pockets: his map, his compass, his parrot. He spins to grab them and **loses** his hat, then his boots. By the time he reaches the plane he has managed to **lose** the plane as well.

The {Wizard} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} building holding a *leaky pot* of swamp potion. *Water drops* of green sludge drip into the pool below. Everyone climbs out **dirty**, covered in slime, with frogs in their hair. The Wizard tries a cleaning spell and makes the pool even more **dirty**.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Pool} and must **cross** to the other side. He balances on a giant *thermometer* floating on the *water drops*, paddling with his drill. Halfway there, the thermometer heats up and boils the water. He makes it **across** just as the pool turns to soup.

The {Cheerleader} cartwheels up the {Staircase} of the {Beach} house holding a giant *square* of cloth on a pole. She plants it in the sand: a **flag** with her face on it. The crabs salute. Then a seagull plants its own **flag** next to hers, with a chip on it.

The {Gardener} plants *candy* on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion}, and lollipop trees burst out of the tiles. Everything turns **sweet**: the rain tastes of syrup, the bricks are fudge, the weather vane is a candy cane. Ants climb up from miles around, and the Gardener has to guard his **sweet** roof with a spoon.

The {Ninja} falls through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Island} and must stand still while a crab pulls his *beard* hair by hair. He clenches his *thumb* and doesn't flinch. He can **endure** anything. The crab calls its friends. The Ninja continues to **endure**, now with a hundred crabs dangling from his chin.

The {Pirate} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring} where a *bearer* carries a *small table* for him to lean on. He'll **rely on** it to stand up after every punch. He swings, misses and leans. Swings, misses, leans. When the bearer walks away, the Pirate has nothing to **rely on** and topples flat.

The {Jockey} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} in a pair of *ski* boots, as a *helping hand* holds out a cactus. It gives him a tiny **prick** on the nose. "Ow!" He jumps, slides off the roof on his skis, and lands in the hot tub, where another cactus waits to **prick** him.

The {Cheerleader} tumbles into the {Basement} of the {Stadium} and finds a tiny *barn* with the last hot dog in the world in it. A *helping hand* shoots out to **grab** it. She leaps. They wrestle over the bun. A goat runs out of the barn and **grabs** the sausage while they're fighting.

The {Shepherd} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} and finds a *busy man* winding a tangle of *silk thread* round his fingers. Every **thread** is the start of a story: a knight, a mummy, a lost sock. The Shepherd pulls one loose **thread**, and the whole tangle unravels across the dinosaur gallery.

The {Tsar} climbs a *stepladder* onto the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} building with a sack of *rice* and a rope to tie it down. But the rope is **thick** as a tree trunk, too **thick** to knot. The Tsar wraps it round the chimney instead and the whole pool building is tied up like a parcel.

The {Juggler} balances on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} with a whole *door* on one **shoulder** and the *moon* on the other. The bankers come out to watch. He shrugs; the door swings open, and coins pour out of the moon onto his other **shoulder**.

The {Lifeguard} runs up the {Staircase} of the {Stadium} with a whole *tree* trunk across her back to hold up the falling roof. She shoves it into place: a giant wooden **beam**. Just in time. The roof creaks and rests on it. The crowd cheers, and birds start nesting on the **beam**.

The {Hunter} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Swan Pond} and sees a silky *cocoon* hanging inside a giant *bracket* on a tree. It opens and out flies a swan made of rainbows. He reaches out, but his hand goes straight through. It's an **illusion**. The pond, the trees, even the Hunter's own boots turn out to be an **illusion**.

The {Firefighter} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Lake} house surrounded by *grass* so sweet it smells of roses. A cloud of butterflies with *spread wings* fans the scent towards her. The air is so **fragrant** that she forgets the fire. The smoke itself turns **fragrant**, like lavender candles.

The {Juggler} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Yeti Cave} and all the yetis come out *all together*. "**All** of you, catch!" He throws snowballs to every yeti at once, and **all** of them catch, and all of them throw them back, and the Juggler disappears under a mountain of snow.

The {Sailor} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room} where a chess *pawn* is trying to crack a *stone* with its tiny head. Bonk, bonk, crack! The stone splits. The pawn gets carried away and starts to **smash** the chairs, the vending machine and the clock. The Sailor shields himself as it **smashes** the fish tank.

The {Jockey} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} and lands under a glass *roof* over a *sprouting field*, where tiny planets are growing like turnips. He plucks one: it's Jupiter. The whole **universe** is sprouting here. He rides off on a comet, pockets full of stars, the **universe** spilling behind him.

The {Sheriff} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} building and finds her *uncle* sunbathing on the chimney in striped trunks. "Come down, **Uncle**!" He waves and does a cannonball off the roof into the pool, splashing the whole town. Every **uncle** in the area climbs up to copy him.

The {Yogi} meditates on the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} until a *mountain* rolls down the steps, shedding a *stone* at every step. Boulders bounce past her nose. She doesn't flinch. A huge **rock** stops right in front of her and starts meditating too. They sit there all day, two **rocks** in the stairwell.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} into a giant bowl of *soup* hanging from the ceiling on ropes of *grass*. It starts to **sway**, left, right, left. Soup sloshes out over the planes. The pilots below **sway** too, seasick, and the Dentist hands out mints.

The {Zookeeper} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} temple, an *ancestral hall*, and ties a *silk thread* to every animal: zebra, parrot, crocodile. She pulls them all together and they **combine** into one creature with stripes, feathers and big teeth. It roars and squawks. She tries to **combine** it with a teapot next.

The {Pirate} struggles up the {Staircase} of the {Spa} as a huge *python* with eagle *talon* feet slithers past him. It starts to **climb** the walls, the steam pipes, the towel rack. The Pirate tries to **climb** after it with his hook, but slips on a bath bomb and lands in the plunge pool.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hut} by the pond, where *grass* gives way to one giant *lotus leaf*. He steps on it and floats off like a raft. A pink **lotus** flower opens beside him, as big as an umbrella. He takes a nap in the **lotus** and drifts out to sea.

The {Shepherd} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} house studying *animal tracks* in the sand below. His *heart* thumps: he **knows** every one. Crab, dog, sheep, octopus. "I **know** who stole my sandwich!" he shouts, and points at a seagull with mustard on its beak.

The {Dentist} falls through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Beach}, where a *sky god* rises out of the *grass* holding a huge cherry by its **stem**. He swings it like a lasso and lets go. The cherry flies off, leaving the god holding only the **stem**, which he uses as a toothpick.

The {Firefighter} hides in the {Basement} of the {Mansion} as a *rebel* runs off down the *road* with her fire engine. A mile later he **returns**, because he forgot the hose. Then he **returns** again for the helmet. On the third trip he just parks it back and goes home.

The {Juggler} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} and finds a deep stone *well* in the middle of the floor. He drops a juggling ball down; it takes ten seconds to splash. A voice from the bottom shouts "Thanks!" and throws back a boxing glove. Every night the **well** sends up more gloves, and the boxers queue at the **well**.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Swamp} hut and lands on the shoulders of a *strongman* lifting an alligator in each hand. He is so **strong** that he lifts the Jockey's horse too, then the whole hut. Frogs cheer. The strongman flexes, and the swamp mud trembles: the **strongest** man in the bog.

The {Baker} runs up the {Staircase} of the {Fort} and rolls out a pancake so **thin** that he can see through it. He spreads it over the *grass* of the *floodplain* below like a sheet of glass. A cow steps on it and it tears like tissue. He makes another, even **thinner**.

The {Cheerleader} tiptoes across the {Rooftop} of the {Cat Café} so **quietly** that the cats don't wake. Her *standing heart* thumps in her chest. She reaches the *portrait* of the head cat and draws a moustache on it. Then she creeps back **quietly**, and the portrait winks at her.

The {Sailor} sweeps the {Basement} of the {Tower} with a giant *comb* held in a *helping hand*. The comb catches dust, spiders, lost socks and a sleeping bat. He has to **sweep** it all up the stairs. The bat wakes up, grabs the comb and starts to **sweep** him out.

The {Magician} tiptoes into the {Basement} of the {Inn} and an *acrobat* flips past so **quick** she leaves a trail of sparkles. She steals the Magician's hat and returns it before he blinks. He pulls a rabbit from it; the acrobat is so **quick** she has already put the rabbit back.

The {Ghost} drifts through the {Trapdoor} of the {Island} hut and finds a *found coin* glued to a huge *stone* blocking every door. It tries to float through, but the stone **hinders** it, wobbling side to side. Crabs try to roll it away, but the coin keeps **hindering** them with its shine.

The {Jockey} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beehive} and finds a *skeleton* holding a *plumb line*, measuring honeycombs. Every cell he checks pops out a new bee. The bees **breed** so fast that the hive grows another storey every minute. The skeleton keeps measuring, and the bees keep on **breeding**.

The {Shepherd} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Stadium} and a *sheep* blocks his path with a *small speech bubble* describing the match. Every pass, every blade of grass, every sneeze. It's so **detailed** that halftime comes and goes. The Shepherd falls asleep, and the sheep starts a **detailed** account of his snoring.

The {Dentist} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beach} house with a lantern, following a *road* through a *sprouting field* of ideas. Each sprout pops a lightbulb. He is suddenly **enlightened**: brush the teeth in circles! The crabs crowd round, eager for him to **enlighten** them too.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Tower} with a long *spear* and pulls a rabbit out of its tip. Then a pigeon. Then a scarf a mile long. The **spear** keeps going. The audience gasps. At the top, he hurls the **spear** into the sky and it turns into a shooting star.

The {Hunter} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} into a dry room, and **suddenly** a *rain* cloud opens. A thousand *sparrow* chicks pour out with the drops, chirping. He opens his umbrella. **Suddenly** it rains upwards and the sparrows all fly back into the cloud.

The {Yogi} meditates in the {Basement} of the {Dunes} hut when a camel slides in a *permit*. "Please **allow** me to sit in your lap." The Yogi stamps it. Then more camels slide in permits. She has to **allow** a whole caravan onto her yoga mat.

The {Firefighter} slides down the {Staircase} of the {Pool} with a *towel* and a *full jar* of water. She stretches the towel across the pool to measure its **width**. Too short! She sews on another towel, and another. Finally she empties the jar and the pool shrinks to the towel's **width**.

The {Sailor} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} and a *helping hand* flings *scattered seeds* everywhere. They **scatter** into the jacuzzi, the sauna and the guests' ears. Flowers pop up from everyone's head. The Sailor joins in, **scattering** glitter, and the whole spa looks like a birthday cake.

The {Sheriff} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Jungle} camp where a *rider* on an elephant hacks at a giant cake with a *standing knife*. Slice after slice goes to the monkeys. Soon only one crumb is left to **remain** on the plate. The Sheriff guards it with her pistol so that something will **remain** for breakfast.

The {King} parades into the {Basement} of the {Island} palace, blowing a *triumph horn*, after winning the coconut-throwing contest. He climbs on a *small table* and does a victory dance. "**Triumph**!" The crabs clap. He blows the horn so hard it shoots him through the roof in **triumph**.

The {King} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Hut} counting every *page* of his diary, where each **grain** of rice is glued. One **grain**, two grains... A *fruit* falls from a tree and squashes them all. He has to start counting again, one tiny grain at a time.

The {Magician} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa} and lands on a *horse* that won't stop its angry *chatter*. "Get off me! You're late! Your hat is silly!" It **scolds** him all the way round the steam room. The Magician turns it into a duck, but the duck **scolds** him even louder.

The {Sheriff} lurks in the {Basement} of the {Hangar} when a pilot hands her a shiny *shell* as a **reward** for catching the plane thief. She's delighted. Then all the other pilots bring shells too, until she is buried in seashells: the biggest **reward** in history.

The {Yogi} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} in the middle of the *night* and lands in a pool of *water drops* that glow green. Everything here is **liquid**: the chairs ripple, the table sloshes, the lamp drips. She tries to sit in lotus and sinks. Even her yoga mat turns to **liquid** and flows out the door.

The {Firefighter} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} and looks down at a *footprint field* full of strange tracks. Kangaroos? Penguins? Boots with curly toes? **Foreign** visitors have landed in the garden. They wave little flags and offer **foreign** sweets that fizz like fireworks, and she sprays them, by accident, with lemonade.

The {Shepherd} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Stadium} next to a *lookout* tower made of *bamboo*, where a huge cardboard **box** sits on top. He opens it: sheep pour out, hundreds of them, onto the pitch. The match stops. He tries to stuff them back into the **box**, but now it's full of footballers.

The {Tailor} perches on the {Rooftop} of the {Yeti Cave} where a *fortune teller* is reading a pile of *shell* stickers. She licks each one and **sticks** it on a yeti's forehead. The yetis can't get them off. The Tailor laughs, so she **sticks** one on his nose that says "Fool".

The {Magician} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} wrapped in a *long veil* soaked in *water drops*. She wrings it out, and water keeps pouring, gallons and gallons. The bathtub begins to **overflow**, then the sink, then the ballroom. Guests float out of the front door as the whole mansion **overflows**.

The {Sailor} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Swan Pond} pavilion with a *handsome man* who pours from a *wine jug*. The Sailor takes a sip, and it's lemon juice: so **sour** his face folds in half. The swans taste it and their necks tie into knots. The handsome man smiles: "Too **sour**? It's vinegar."

The {Lifeguard} jogs up the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} where a nervous *bridegroom* is waiting by a plane in a top hat. He's a **young man** of twenty with a bouquet of fish. The bride parachutes in. The **young man** faints, and the Lifeguard has to give him the kiss of life first.

The {Yogi} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} under the full *moon* and wraps a hula hoop around her **waist**. She spins it faster and faster, until the moon itself starts orbiting her **waist** like a silver belt. The owls clap with their wings.

The {Sheriff} lies on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} building inside a tiny *hut*, where the locals leave her an *offering* of cushions, iced tea and a foot massage. She takes off her badge and starts to **relax**. Her boots slide off. Even her pistol takes a nap. The whole town learns to **relax** under her snoring.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Lake} house with one *raised brow*, which keeps going up, up, off his face, and floats away like a caterpillar. He chases the **eyebrow** across the lake. It lands on a duck, who suddenly looks very surprised. Now the duck wants his other **eyebrow** too.

The {Yogi} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse} with a *standing heart* that has a *wart* on its nose. It paces back and forth. "What if it rains? What if the boats sink?" It begins to **worry** so much that it turns grey. The Yogi tells it not to **worry** and a boat promptly sinks.

The {Firefighter} slides down the {Staircase} of the {Pool} and finds a little *hatchling* riding on *water drops* like a raft. It starts to **float** up, up, out of the pool and into the air. The Firefighter grabs its foot and **floats** too. Together they drift over the diving board, waving at the lifeguards.

The {Shepherd} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} and plants a red *chili* in a pot on the chimney. He has to **toil** all day: watering, weeding, chasing off pigeons. His sweat steams. The chili grows to the size of a car and he must **toil** all night to pick it.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} and meets a *sweating man* holding out a giant red *heart*. He's in **love**, with her. He drips nervously. She blows her whistle: it's **love** at first sight. The bankers throw coins like confetti.

The {Tsar} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} at a long table while a *bone picker* serves every dish of *food* in the kingdom: soup, roasts, puddings, more soup. The **meal** goes on for three days. The Tsar's crown stops fitting. The bone picker tidies up and immediately starts the next **meal**.

The {Shepherd} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Piazza} and runs *downstairs* into the dark. A huge *mouth* yells "BOO!" He leaps three feet in the air. It's enough to **scare** the pigeons out of the square. Then the mouth tries to **scare** a statue, and the statue jumps too.

The {Tailor} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} and finds a *courtyard* where every tree is bent. A *helping hand* grabs each trunk and pulls it **straight**, like an ironing board. The Tailor stands up **straight** too. Then a boxer walks in slouching, and the hand straightens him with a twang.

The {Lifeguard} falls through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Beach}, where a *strong arm* sharpens a sword on a *whetstone*. She cheers: "Go on! You can do it!" She keeps shouting to **encourage** it. The arm sharpens faster, and the sword gleams. Then it turns to **encourage** her to swim to the horizon.

The {Tsar} storms up the {Staircase} of the {Beehive} with a red *chili* on his *tongue*. He breathes fire and shouts, "I **resign**!" He throws down his crown. The queen bee picks it up and puts it on. Then all the worker bees **resign** too, and the honey has to make itself.

The {Sailor} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse} counting every *boat* in the harbour for a white-bearded *elder*. "One 艘, two 艘, three 艘!" Every ship needs the **counter for ships**, 艘, and each one honks when counted. The elder falls asleep before the hundredth **counter for ships**.

The {Juggler} falls through the {Trapdoor} into the {Yen Exchange} where a *builder* has bricked up the vault. Inside are a billion *gold coins*. He hands the Juggler a **key** the size of an oar. The Juggler juggles it, drops it, and the **key** turns itself in the lock with a click.

The {Wizard} hides in the {Basement} of the {Pool} building with a *standing person* holding a *spool* of rope. They tie five swimmers into a **squad**. "March!" The squad dives in together, still tied, and spins like a propeller. The Wizard adds a sixth, and the **squad** sinks.

The {Firefighter} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} temple and finds a *mountain* sitting on it, its snowy *peak* poking the clouds. She climbs to the **peak** with her hose. From the top she sprays the whole jungle, and the monkeys build a smaller **peak** out of bananas to copy her.

The {Chef} crawls into the {Basement} of the {Beehive} with a wooden *ruler* marked in **Chinese foot** units, each a third of a metre. He measures the honeycomb: three feet. A bee stings him. He measures the swelling: one **Chinese foot**.

The {Zookeeper} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Warehouse} and finds a *jack-in-the-box* popping up with a *sun* on its head. "That was **yesterday**!" it squeaks. She checks her calendar. It is! Every box in the warehouse pops open, all shouting about **yesterday**.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beach} house and sees a **multitude** of people pouring onto the sand: farmers, sailors, grandmothers, babies, ice-cream sellers. Thousands, millions, too many to count. She blows her whistle and the whole **multitude** dives into the sea at once, and the tide goes out.

The {Baker} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} house onto a wooden *cart* where a grandmother, mother and baby sit, each with *spread wings*. Each **generation** flaps in turn. The grandmother flies first, then the mother, then the baby. The Baker bakes three cakes, one for each **generation**, and the baby eats them all.

The {Gardener} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Swan Pond} and threads a *string of coins* onto a long spear. He thrusts it forward, and it **pierces through** a swan's floating hat, an apple, and the reeds. It keeps going and **pierces through** the pond, coming out the other side of the Earth.

The {Jockey} creeps across the {Rooftop} of the {Funfair}'s helter-skelter as a *standing person* consults an *oracle* in a glass ball. "Where's the stolen candyfloss?" The **spy** pulls on a fake moustache and slides down the helter-skelter. The Jockey follows, now a **spy** too, both disguised as clowns.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Water Park} and treads on a *bone* covered in *water drops*. Whoosh! It's **slippery** as soap. He slides down every slide, through the lazy river and into the wave pool. Even his boots are **slippery** now.

The {Cheerleader} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mint} where *rolling hands* are printing tickets and a *knife* chops them apart. One flutters to her: a golden **ticket**. "Free cartwheels for life!" She waves it around and a thousand cartwheeling strangers chase her for the **ticket**.

The {Chef} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Lagoon} temple, an *ancestral hall* perched on a *mountain* that keeps growing. The steps go up and up into the clouds. It's so **lofty** that eagles live in the kitchen. The Chef serves soup at the top, in this **lofty** spot where the stars stir the pot.

The {Robot} hides in the {Basement} of the {Tower}, trying to recharge, but a *helping hand* keeps poking the *wart* on its metal nose. Beep! The robot jumps. Poke! Beep! It can't sleep. The hand loves to **disturb** it. In revenge, the robot plays loud music to **disturb** the whole tower.

The {Shepherd} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} and a *front runner* sprints in under the *roof*, waving a scroll. "The **constitution**! The law of the land!" He reads rule one: sheep may vote. The Shepherd cheers. Rule two: sheep must wear ties. The sheep protest the **constitution**.

The {Robot} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} and an *emperor* starts to **wind around** it with *silk thread*, round and round, like a spool. The Robot spins. The emperor keeps going, tower top to bottom, until the whole building is wound up. The threads **wind around** the flagpole, too.

The {Cheerleader} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Museum} as a *runner* sprints past carrying a bale of *hay*. "**Hurry**! The horses are hungry!" She grabs some hay and races after him. The statues **hurry** behind them, clanking, and the dinosaur bones run fastest of all.

The {Tsar} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beehive} with a *magnet* on a string and a soft *heart* in his pocket. He drags the magnet past every lost bee and pulls them gently home. He is so **kind** that he knits tiny scarves for the drones. The queen calls him the most **kind** Tsar ever.

The {Cheerleader} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Cat Café} on a pair of *stilts*, and keeps climbing. She gets so **tall** that her head pokes out of the roof. The cats climb up her legs to sit on her shoulders. She's so **tall** now that pigeons try to nest in her ponytail.

The {Yogi} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Ice Rink} and lands by a *gate* where a *money changer* swaps coins for books. She skates round and round to **read** each page as she passes. The money changer charges per word. By the end of the night she has **read** a whole encyclopedia and is broke.

The {Hunter} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} into a boiling cellar, where clothes hang on a *drying rack*. He starts to **sweat**. *Water drops* pour off him, filling buckets, soaking the clothes again. The butler wrings out his shirt, and the **sweat** floods the hallway.

The {Jockey} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive}, where a *tree* is growing out of the chimney. He grabs a *branch* to steady himself. The **branch** grows longer, carrying him over the garden, the river, and into the next town, where it drops him onto another **branch**.

The {Tailor} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Warehouse} as a *helping hand* grabs a *snake* by the tail and starts to **drag** it across the tiles. The snake hisses and **drags** the hand back. They tug-of-war over the chimney until the Tailor sews them both into a scarf.

The {Magician} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Fort} into a pile of black *soot* mixed with wet *soil*. He stirs it with his wand into thick **ink**. He writes a spell on the wall, and the words climb off and start marching. The soldiers are now covered in **ink** footprints.

The {Shepherd} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yeti Cave} under the *moon* and finds a yeti's *workshop* full of spiky tools. The yeti waves a hammer. "Give me your sheep or else!" It's trying to **threaten** him. The Shepherd waves a sheep back, and the yeti, scared of sheep, stops trying to **threaten** anyone.

The {Chef} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} with a corn *husker* in a *helping hand*. He has to **insert** a corncob into every chimney. Pop! Pop! Smoke comes out as popcorn. He tries to **insert** one into a guest's ear, and the guest pops too.

The {Juggler} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} juggling *bamboo* sticks. One flies off the *front* of his hand, straight as an **arrow**, and pins a banker's tie to the wall. Another **arrow** knocks a coin out of a piggy bank. The Juggler bows and takes a bow and arrow on tour.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa} into the steam room, where strips of *sun-dried meat* hang drying under a fake *moon*. The steam turns them into **cured meat**, salty and smoky. Guests sniff hungrily. The Lifeguard hands out slices, and the sauna becomes a **cured meat** shop.

The {Firefighter} falls into the {Basement} of the {Funfair}, where someone has dropped a sack of *rice* into the cake mixer next to a *cut cake*. The mixer grinds everything into fine white **powder**. A puff of wind, and the whole funfair turns white. The Firefighter sneezes **powder** for a week.

The {Ninja} sneaks up the {Staircase} of the {Beach} house, where a *nun* is making sandcastles with *water drops* poured onto the sand. It turns to sticky **mud**. The Ninja slips, slides, and becomes a sandcastle himself. The nun crowns him with a seashell and builds a **mud** moat round him.

The {Sheriff} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} into a huge *family tree* drawn on the honeycomb. Every bee's **surname** is written on it: Buzz, Buzz, Buzz. She adds her own name, Sheriff, and the bees argue about whether she can take their **surname**.
